title: Color Correction in Photoshop: Non-destructive Camera Raw Auto and White Balance Eyedropper (PHLEARN Day 20)
summary: This PHLEARN tutorial demonstrates a fast, non-destructive workflow to color correct photos in Photoshop using the Camera Raw filter. After converting the image to a Smart Object, the host shows color correction techniques applicable to both RAW and JPEG images: using the White Balance Eyedropper to target a neutral gray, discussing the gray-card practice for reliable white balance, and employing the Auto button in Camera Raw for automatic color correction. The instructor emphasizes non-destructive editing by enabling/disabling the smart filter, compares before/after results to illustrate improvements in color and skin tones, and suggests that Auto often performs well across different image formats. The session closes with guidance on when to use these techniques and a tease for the next day's color grading lesson.
